title: Handling User Input and Forms
description: Learn how to capture and manage user input in React Native apps using TextInput, Buttons, Forms, and proper state handling.

lessons.title: Introduction to Forms and Inputs
lessons.content: Forms are used to collect data from users. In React Native, components like TextInput, Switch, and Button are used to create interactive forms. Handling these inputs involves using state to track user changes.

lessons.title: Using TextInput for Text Fields
Handling Button Presses
Creating a Basic Form with State
Keyboard Avoidance and Input Focus
lessons.content:
```jsx
import { KeyboardAvoidingView, Platform, TextInput, Button } from 'react-native';

<KeyboardAvoidingView behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : 'height'}>
  <TextInput placeholder="Username" />
  <Button title="Submit" onPress={() => {}} />
</KeyboardAvoidingView>
```

lessons.title: Input Validation Basics
Working with Checkboxes and Switches
Using Pickers and Dropdowns
Managing Form State with a Single Object
Best Practices for Forms
lessons.content:
- Use controlled components with state
- Validate inputs before submitting
- Use `KeyboardAvoidingView` on iOS
- Keep form components modular
- Use libraries like Formik or React Hook Form for complex forms
